observations: A standing salon hood hair dryer (bonnet-style), cream/white hood with a smoked plastic visor, mounted on a tall stand.
Brand badge 'EQUATOR' is clearly visible on the hood in photo 1 and photo 2, with what appears to be a model mark '2' underneath it in photo 2.
Unit stands in what looks like a home salon room, near a barred window, with a mannequin head and a separate handheld dryer visible in the background.
Visor/plastic shield shows some scuffing and a visible crack or seam line near the bottom edge in photo 1 and 2.
Power cord is visible hanging down but the plug end and switch area are not shown clearly in any photo.
No photo shows the dryer powered on, heating, or blowing air.

identity.kind: standing hood hair dryer (salon bonnet dryer)

claims.evidence: No photo or clip shows the unit running, heating, or blowing air; 'fairly used' condition cannot be judged from static photos alone.

risks.risk: Heating element or motor may not work (no power-on evidence)
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the dryer plugged in, switched on, hood warming and air blowing

risks.risk: Cracked or damaged visor/hood plastic could mean heat leakage or breakage risk
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the crack/seam line at the base of the visor
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically damaged, worst case

risks.risk: Condition of power cord and plug (fraying, exposed wire) not visible
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the plug and the full length of the cord
risks.if_unproven: priced as unsafe wiring until shown otherwise

risks.risk: Stability of the stand/base (wobble, rust at joints) cannot be judged from these angles
risks.proof: A photo of the base and wheels/feet from floor level

risks.risk: Timer/heat-setting dial function unknown, no control panel shown clearly
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the control panel/dial

proof_requests: Video of the dryer plugged in and running, showing hood heating and airflow
Close-up photo of the control panel, dial, and switch
Close-up photo of the plug and full cord length
Close-up photo of the crack/seam on the visor
Photo of the base/stand from floor level
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as an Equator-brand standing hood hair dryer, but with no proof of power-on function, cord safety, or visor integrity, it must be priced at worst case as a non-working, cosmetically flawed unit until the seller supplies the listed proof.
